description: This Java class 'EmailDataValidator' provides validation methods for email-related data, including request validation for creating and updating email campaigns, email format validation, recipient validation, and JSON parameter validation within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: EmailDataValidator
classes.description: A final class providing validation methods for email campaign data, including create/update request validation, email format validation, recipient validation, and JSON parameter validation.

methods.name: validateCreateRequest
methods.description: Validates the JSON request for creating a new email campaign, checking required fields, formats, and date parsing.

methods.name: validateUpdateRequest
methods.description: Validates the JSON request for updating an existing email campaign, with similar checks as create but optional fields.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Checks if a given email string matches the email regex pattern and basic validity rules.

methods.name: validateEmailRecipients
methods.description: Splits and validates a comma-separated string of email addresses, returning a set of valid emails.

methods.name: validateStretchyReportParamMap
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a HashMap, returning null if invalid.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if there are any validation errors collected.
